title: Zodiac Hour w/Nanagotchi Transit Mix: Aries Saturn RX
body: On July 26th, Saturn went retrograde in the sign of Aries. Saturn is a planet that values discipline, patience, and structure. Aries is a sign that acts intuitively and in the moment. These clashing energies will be going retrograde until December 10. Until then, anything without a strong foundation will crumble and impulsive actions will be met with immediate consequence. My interpretation of this energy is embodied into this mix. Enjoy :3 and good luck to everyone through this Saturn RX
